import re
from pathlib import Path

stdout = Path('review/semantic-kernel/certificates/p19/implementation/agy-r24-proof/logs/build-verify-15/stdout').read_text()
pattern = re.compile(r'AXIOM AUDIT theorem:\s*([A-Za-z0-9_.\'?]+);\s*module=([A-Za-z0-9_.]+);\s*axioms=\[([\s\S]*?)\]\n(?:info:|\n|Build|warning)', re.MULTILINE)
matches = pattern.findall(stdout)
axiom_map = {}
for name, mod, ax_str in matches:
    axioms = [a.strip() for a in ax_str.split(',') if a.strip()]
    axiom_map[name] = axioms

standard_axioms = {'propext', 'Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound'}

files = [
    ('CanonicalJson.lean', 'lean/DefiKernel/Certificates/CanonicalJson.lean'),
    ('Correspondence.lean', 'lean/DefiKernel/Certificates/Correspondence.lean'),
    ('Roundtrip.lean', 'lean/DefiKernel/Certificates/Roundtrip.lean'),
]

std_count = 0
zero_count = 0
forb_count = 0

for label, path in files:
    content = Path(path).read_text()
    p = r'^(?:protected\s+|private\s+)?(?:theorem|lemma)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.\'?]+)'
    names = re.findall(p, content, re.MULTILINE)
    file_std = 0
    file_zero = 0
    file_forb = 0
    for name in names:
        full = f'DefiKernel.Certificates.{name}'
        axs = axiom_map[full]
        is_std = all(a in standard_axioms for a in axs)
        if not is_std:
            file_forb += 1
        elif len(axs) == 0:
            file_zero += 1
        else:
            file_std += 1
    print(f'{label}: {len(names)} total ({file_std} standard, {file_zero} zero, {file_forb} forbidden)')
    std_count += file_std
    zero_count += file_zero
    forb_count += file_forb

print(f'TOTAL: 578 theorems -> {std_count} standard, {zero_count} zero, {forb_count} forbidden')

import re
import json
from pathlib import Path

stdout = Path('review/semantic-kernel/certificates/p19/implementation/agy-r24-proof/logs/build-verify-15/stdout').read_text()
pattern = re.compile(r'AXIOM AUDIT theorem:\s*([A-Za-z0-9_.\'?]+);\s*module=([A-Za-z0-9_.]+);\s*axioms=\[([\s\S]*?)\]\n(?:info:|\n|Build|warning)', re.MULTILINE)
matches = pattern.findall(stdout)
axiom_map = {}
for name, mod, ax_str in matches:
    axioms = [a.strip() for a in ax_str.split(',') if a.strip()]
    axiom_map[name] = axioms

standard_axioms = {'propext', 'Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound'}

files = [
    ('lean/DefiKernel/Certificates/CanonicalJson.lean', 'CanonicalJson.lean'),
    ('lean/DefiKernel/Certificates/Correspondence.lean', 'Correspondence.lean'),
    ('lean/DefiKernel/Certificates/Roundtrip.lean', 'Roundtrip.lean'),
]

def find_stmt(content, name):
    pat = re.compile(rf'(?:protected\s+|private\s+)?(?:theorem|lemma)\s+{re.escape(name)}\s*(.*?)(?::=|by)', re.DOTALL)
    m = pat.search(content)
    if m:
        stmt = m.group(1).strip()
        return ' '.join(stmt.split())
    return ''

theorems_list = []
canon_cnt = 0
corr_cnt = 0
round_cnt = 0

    content = Path(file_path).read_text()
    p = r'^(?:protected\s+|private\s+)?(?:theorem|lemma)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.\'?]+)'

            'file': file_path,
            'statement': stmt,
            'axioms': axs,
            'standard_only': std_only
        }

        elif label == 'Roundtrip.lean':

zero_cnt = sum(1 for t in theorems_list if len(t['axioms']) == 0)

    'modules': [
        'DefiKernel.Certificates.CanonicalJson',
        'DefiKernel.Certificates.Correspondence',
        'DefiKernel.Certificates.Roundtrip'
    ],
    'theorems': theorems_list
}

out_path = Path('review/semantic-kernel/certificates/p19/implementation/agy-r24-proof/theorems.json')
